summary: The registrant filed an 8-K solely to declare routine monthly distributions on its common stock classes for July 2026. The filing reports gross distributions of $0.0770 per share for Class I, D, T, and S shares, with net amounts reflecting stockholder servicing fees, payable to holders of record on July 31, 2026, paid on or about August 5, 2026. This is a standard distribution announcement typical of a real estate investment trust, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
